record.original_question: Let G be a bounded simply connected planar domain whose boundary is a piecewise analytic Jordan curve without cusps, and let {p_n} be its Bergman orthogonal polynomials with exterior conformal map Φ and boundary capacity cap(∂G). Is it true that the leading coefficients and the exterior values of p_n satisfy the strong asymptotic formulas λ_n = √((n+1)/π) cap(∂G)^{-(n+1)}(1+O(1/n)) and p_n(z) = √((n+1)/π) Φ'(z) Φ(z)^n (1+O(1/n)) uniformly for z in the exterior domain?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 10.1. Assume that the boundary Γ of G is a piecewise analytic Jordan curve without cusps. Then ... λ_n ... (1 + O(1/n)) ... and p_n(z) ... (1 + O(1/n)).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G\subset\mathbb{C}$ be a bounded simply connected domain whose boundary $\Gamma=\partial G$ is a piecewise analytic Jordan curve without cusps (i.e. a finite union of analytic arcs meeting at corners with interior angles in $(0,2\pi)$, none of which equals $0$ or $2\pi$). Let $\Omega:=\overline{\mathbb{C}}\setminus\overline{G}$ be the exterior domain, and let $\Phi:\Omega\to\{w:|w|>1\}$ be the conformal map normalized by $\Phi(\infty)=\infty$ and $\Phi'(\infty)>0$, so that $\mathrm{cap}(\Gamma)=1/\Phi'(\infty)$ is the logarithmic capacity of $\Gamma$.

Let $\{p_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ be the sequence of Bergman orthogonal polynomials of $G$, i.e. the polynomials $p_n(z)=\lambda_n z^n+\cdots$ with $\lambda_n>0$ that are orthonormal with respect to the area measure on $G$:
$$\int_G p_n(z)\,\overline{p_m(z)}\,dA(z)=\delta_{n,m}.$$

Prove or disprove the following two strong asymptotic formulas:

1. (Leading coefficient asymptotics)
$$\lambda_n=\sqrt{\frac{n+1}{\pi}}\,\mathrm{cap}(\Gamma)^{-(n+1)}\bigl(1+O(1/n)\bigr),\qquad n\to\infty.$$

2. (Exterior asymptotics) Uniformly for $z\in\Omega$,
$$p_n(z)=\sqrt{\frac{n+1}{\pi}}\,\Phi'(z)\,\Phi(z)^{n}\bigl(1+O(1/n)\bigr),\qquad n\to\infty.$$
artifact.status_search_result: For piecewise analytic Jordan curves without cusps, strong asymptotics for the leading coefficients $\lambda_n$ and for $p_n$ outside $G$ have been established, with an error term of order $O(1/n)$ shown to be best possible in the leading-coefficient asymptotics (Miña-Díaz and collaborators, Constr. Approx. 2013; Numer. Algorithms 2015). The conjectured uniform $O(1/n)$ exterior asymptotic with an explicit constant has been proved in many cases but extensions and refinements (e.g. for general piecewise analytic boundaries, including all corner configurations) continue to be developed; the precise conjecture as stated appears partially resolved rather than completely closed.

status_evidence.title: Strong Asymptotics for Bergman Polynomials over Domains with Corners and Applications
status_evidence.snippet: Strong asymptotics for Bergman orthogonal polynomials defined over Jordan domains with corners, extending Carleman (1923) and Suetin's results.
status_evidence.claim: Strong asymptotics for Bergman polynomials over corner domains established.

status_evidence.title: On the leading coefficient of polynomials orthogonal over domains with corners
status_evidence.snippet: For piecewise analytic Jordan curves without cusps, alpha_n = O(1/n) as n→∞, and this rate is in general best possible.
status_evidence.claim: O(1/n) rate for leading coefficient established and shown best possible.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotics of Bergman polynomials for domains with reflection-invariant corners
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) work continuing to refine asymptotics of Bergman polynomials in domains with corners.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on Bergman polynomial asymptotics for corner domains.
